description: Screenshot of an 'Advisory Council' section of an organization's website showing six black-and-white headshots with names and bios: Wally Adeyemo, Jamie Barnett, Jeremy Bash, Rand Beers, Howard Berman, and Tony Blinken. Blinken's bio notes he is Managing Director of the Penn Biden Center and Co-Founder of WestExec Advisors. The hosting organization is not named in the visible crop; the roster matches the advisory board of National Security Action, a group of former Obama-administration national security officials.
text: ADVISORY COUNCIL. Wally Adeyemo. Wally Adeyemo served as Deputy National Security Advisor for International Economics (2015-2017). He is a Senior Advisor to the Center for Strategic and International Studies. Jamie Barnett. Rear Admiral (Ret.) Barnett served as Deputy Commander, Navy Expeditionary Combat Command and the Pentagon's Director of Naval Education and Training. Follow on Twitter. Jeremy Bash. Jeremy Bash served as Chief of Staff of the CIA (2009-2011) and Defense Department (2011-2013). Rand Beers. Rand Beers served as Deputy Homeland Security Advisor (2014-2015). Howard Berman. Representative Howard Berman served as a Member of Congress (1983-2013). Tony Blinken. Tony Blinken served as Deputy Secretary of State (2015-2017) and as Deputy National Security Advisor (2013-2015). He is a Managing Director of the Penn Biden Center for Diplomacy and Global Engagement and a Co-Founder of WestExec Advisors. Follow on Twitter.
orgs: Center for Strategic and International Studies
Penn Biden Center for Diplomacy and Global Engagement
flags: Hosting organization not named in the visible crop; identification as National Security Action's advisory council is inferred from the roster, not shown.

This is Trump's claim/demand as tweeted.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Following. I hereby demand, and will do so officially tomorrow, that the Department of Justice look into whether or not the FBI/DOJ infiltrated or surveilled the Trump Campaign for Political Purposes - and if any such demands or requests were made by people within the Obama Administration! 1:37 PM - 20 May 2018

The tweet claims Strzok-Page texts refer to a counter-intelligence operation into the Trump campaign dating back to December 2015 and declares 'SPYGATE is in full force!' The article text restates the president's claim.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Wow, Strzok-Page, the incompetent & corrupt FBI lovers, have texts referring to a counter-intelligence operation into the Trump Campaign dating way back to December, 2015. SPYGATE is in full force! Is the Mainstream Media interested yet? Big stuff! 7:37 PM - Jun 5, 2018. 86.9K. 44.2K people are talking about this.
